title: Hold a vial up to a counting tray's chute with one hand while the other tips the tray to pour ten counted tablets
instruction: Pour the ten counted tablets in the counting tray's trough into the vial, and none of the others: hold the vial up off the table under the tray's chute with one hand, and with the other lift the tray by its grip fin and tip it back.
context: Counting tablets on a counting tray and pouring the count into a vial is a core pharmacy-technician task. The counted tablets wait in the tray's trough while the rest stay on its floor, and the vial is held right up to the chute so none bounce out. A robot that dispenses medicines must get the count exactly right.
setup: A table in front of two arms (bases 61 cm apart), seen by one overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Distances are measured forward from the line between the arm bases and sideways from the midpoint between them. (1) A loose blue ABS-plastic counting tray, 60 g, 9 x 8 cm with rims 1.5 cm tall, centred 31.5 cm forward and 4 cm left of the centre line. Along its right side runs a trough 2 cm wide behind a divider 8 mm high; the trough opens at the back into a chute 3.5 cm long. A grip fin 1.2 cm thick stands on the front rim and reaches 5 cm forward, 1.2 to 4.8 cm above the table. (2) 16 loose white tablets (pressed powder), discs 8 mm across and 3.5 mm thick: the 10 counted ones in two rows of five near the front of the trough, 6 extras on the tray's floor. (3) An empty square amber polypropylene vial, 5 x 5 cm and 4.5 cm tall, 20 g, standing 18 cm forward and 6.5 cm right of the centre line. The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: Judged at the end of the trial. In the vial: a tablet's centre inside the vial. Spilt: a tablet neither in the vial nor on the tray. Held up: the vial's underside at least 2 cm off the table when the first tablet went in. 1.0: the 10 counted tablets in the vial and none of the 6 extras, none spilt, and the vial held up; 0.5: 9 to 11 tablets in the vial; 0.25: at least 1 in the vial; else 0.0. The trial ends at the run limit, or once the full score has held with everything still for 1 s.
reset_notes: Put the ten counted tablets back in two rows near the front of the trough and the six extras on the tray's floor, lay the tray where it was and stand the empty vial in its place.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (Isaac Sim 6.1, PhysX, 20 Hz control). Simplified: the tablets are 16 rigid discs (8 mm across, 0.3 g), slick like film-coated tablets (friction 0.15); the tray and the vial are rigid, and the vial is a square open box. Cameras 1280 x 704 (Dream-1 sees 320 x 176).
